title: Epitaph Prime
extract:
Epitaph Prime is the Primed counterpart of  Epitaph wrist-mounted sidearm, with slight improvements to its damage and already high critical chance and critical multiplier, charged shot's status chance, and uncharged shot's fire rate and explosion radius. Additionally, charged shots have a guaranteed  Cold status proc. Epitaph Prime was released alongside  Sevagoth Prime and  Nautilus Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals pure  Blast damage uncharged and primarily  Slash damage fully charged.
Shots have a guaranteed  Impact proc on direct hits.
Uncharged shots:
Tied with  Epitaph,  Kuva Nukor and  Tysis for the highest status chance of all secondaries.
Explodes in a 10 meter radius on impact with a surface or enemy.
Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
Can benefit from  Fulmination ( Primed).
Has a guaranteed  Cold proc.
Charged shots:
Highest critical chance of all secondaries.
High critical multiplier.
Very fast charge speed.
Innate 2 meter punch through.
Has a guaranteed  Cold proc.
Deals +20% headshot damage when wielded by  Sevagoth/ Sevagoth Prime.
 Magnum Force's accuracy penalty is minimal on this weapon.
Innate two  polarities.
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

No magazine; does not need to reload.
